actionSummary.title: actionSummary
actionSummary.description: A SHORT one-line card title ONLY, e.g. Book Canyon Zip Line for 2 guests. Do not list facts or price here.

opaqueId.title: opaqueId
opaqueId.description: The pairwise BotShield opaque ID of the approver. Mapped automatically from the conversation; never an email.

detailLabel.title: detailLabel
detailLabel.description: REQUIRED for bookings: set to exactly TOTAL.

detailValue.title: detailValue
detailValue.description: REQUIRED for bookings: the total as currency = session Price × number of guests, e.g. $300.00. Only money goes here.

detailsJson.title: detailsJson
detailsJson.description: JSON array (as a string) of the booking facts, each {"title":"...","value":"..."}: EXPERIENCE, DATE, START, GUESTS. Never include money here.
